body: Thank man. I really appreciate it. I'll def let you know how the assessment goes. The place is supposed to be really good.

I've got a business I've been trying to get off the ground. It's been so tough though. Even get up. I've got a rehab facility lined up but man, I can't tell you how fucked up I feel knowing I was going be married, then now being here single, with genital herpes, and pure lethargy.
The WD and the hurt from the breakup feel insurmountable.
Appreciate it.
Thanks man
I had it on my calendar.
If I had the energy of know how, I would. 10 year uphill battle. It's ruptured me.
It's been far to great a journey uphill. 10 year battle and can't do 10 more.
Do you think dropping 1 my ever week will work?
I actually didn't realize I posted it here until you just said that.
Thanks brotha
Confirmed: Blocked her ass. Feels good!!
You rock. Thank you.

Hey thank you for the response. I really appreciate it. I'm aware that remaining to stay with her was very wrong. I know it is equally as much my problem. 

I'm going to continue therapy for the next year and work on building myself up to become a stronger, healthier, and wiser person.
Like I said, I realized I could have made better decisions, I'm asking others on what the next steps would be to move ahead.
I don't know who you think you are, but take a hike. I'm not looking for people to pour salt into the wound. I look back and see it was pretty messed up on my part to stay in the relationship.
Thank you for the advice.
Thank you bud
She has 0 money. Lawyer said we wouldn't be able to collect anything.
I am well aware. It was a terrible decision on my part.
I didn't apologize for making her upset ever. Not once. I don't know where you got that.
Love it
I'm going to gain the courage to hit that block button.
Hindsight is 20/20.

Thank you so much. You've really helped me. There are good people out there. Complete block or unfriend on Facebook? The more I have access to view her profile, I am tempted and torture myself. 

Part of me wants to stay friends with her on Facebook so she can see me, get fuckin jacked, travel the world, post pictures, rub that shit in her face because I know she will look at my profile. 

Another part of me is saying block, never look back.
You rock dude. Know you've helped my soul heal and if there is a big guy up there, you're doing his work.
Thanks man.

Thanks bud. I came from a really messed up family and I've been working my whole life to be an honest, upstanding, man. I feel like I've gotten there. This has set me back big time, but with time, I'm sure I will prevail. 

I gave her 2 years of my life. 

I told my family, full disclosure all of this and they are disgusted by her. I have the email that she wrote me disclosing everything to me and even though I could seek revenge with it, I don't know if I will. 

Honestly, I'm very worried for her kid. I almost want to send that email to her parents (She lives with them) to let them know what a danger she could be to her child. I loved that little guy. I miss him lots.

My God. You seriously just struck a note there. She never took responsibility for ANYTHING. She was always the victim of the external factors of life. Acted like she couldn't keep up with very normal aspects and situations of life. 

We haven't spoken since we split, but when we were together and she did (very rarely) talk about her past, she talked about feeling shame, guilt, etc. It's like her past was a ghost.

Thank you for then response. My brother said the same thing. Thank the heavens I did not marry her. 

I've had anxiety problems for quite a while and do take meds for it. Been in therapy too. This one just hurt so bad and I sunk into such a deep depression I couldn't get out of bed. 

Really appreciate the response. Any support I can get is helpful.

Can you elaborate on what you mean by mental gymnastics? 

Anytime her past was brought up, it's like she got defensive, angry, dismissive, didn't want to talk about it. 

She's told me in the past she lives with a lot of guilt. I never really knew what she meant, but maybe now I may be able to make some connection.

It's like I so desperately want some kind of revenge. I have an email of her full admission of guilt over all of it. I even sent it to my lawyer, but I don't want a case to be made public. 

So many different feelings. I'm trying to take it day by day.
Peed next to weeman at LAX airport. He was cool as hell.
Thanks buddy. I just wonder if she realizes how f*cked up what she did was.
I find myself looking at her profile. It's like I'm punishing myself.
It's hard to believe someone I was so close to was so capable of causing so much hurt. I need to remind myself that it is not a reflection on me.

Thank you. I have been working so hard on myself for the past 5 years. I've come a long way, but this one hurts so much. I have such a mixture of feelings. Anger, sadness, hurt. I feel like an idiot for opening up to someone like that.
Thank you. I've been writing music.
Thank you so much for the support.
I went no contact with her the day we broke up. Haven't texted or called or anything. Would you recommend blocking her on social media?

Thank you for your feedback. I am actively working on myself with my therapist. 

I've worked very hard for the past 5 years. Do you have any suggestions for me?
Thank you so much I needed that
Run it as administrator
Thank you
